name: Justice Department
description: Follow Justice Department, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump appeals ruling that found his $10B IRS suit aimed to ‘manipulate’ legal proceedings
changes.summary: The case is at the center of negotiations between two Republican senators and the Justice Department over Todd Blanche’s nomination to serve as attorney general.

changes.title: DOJ admits legal errors, drops subpoenas of New York Times journalists
changes.summary: A judge criticized the Justice Department for legal errors that ultimately led the agency to withdraw its subpoenas of two New York Times journalists who wrote a story about security concerns on President Trump's Qatari-gifted Air Force One. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman has the latest.

changes.title: Republicans urge Justice Department to investigate former prosecutor Jack Smith
changes.summary: The former special counsel led two criminal investigations of President Trump and has been a frequent target of Trump's ire on social media. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: DOJ to withdraw subpoenas for New York Times reporters over Air Force One story
changes.summary: The New York Times moved to block subpoenas issued by the Justice Department for grand jury testimony and phone records from its reporters.

changes.title: Rep. Jim Jordan formally asks DOJ to prosecute Jack Smith
changes.summary: House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, R-Ohio,sent a letter to the Justice Department requesting a criminal investigation of former special counsel Jack Smith, alleging he made false statements during a congressional deposition last year. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports on Jordan's referral.

changes.title: Justice Department activates untested court for 'alien terrorist' deportations
changes.summary: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court was established in 1996 but had never received a petition until this past Wednesday.

changes.title: Blanche holds meeting with Epstein accusers after Tillis' request
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche met with accusers of Jeffrey Epstein following a demand to do so by a Republican senator whose support is crucial to advancing his nomination to lead the Justice Department.

changes.title: New York Times files motion to quash subpoenas served on journalists over Air Force One coverage
changes.summary: The New York Times on Wednesday filed a motion to quash subpoenas that the Justice Department served on journalists who reported on security concerns involving the new, Qatari-gifted Air Force One, teeing up a significant court fight pitting press freedom against the the government's ability to force reporters to ident.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Faces Crucial Hurdle Ahead of Confirmation as Attorney General
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination is broadly a referendum on President Trump’s vision of the Justice Department as a projection of his power.
